lines.zh: 白桦树皮反光，我在上面认路
lines.en: The birch bark shines, and I read my way along it.

lines.zh: 巢屋就在第三棵白桦上
lines.en: Our nest house sits on the third birch.

lines.zh: 天黑了，该出巢找食了
lines.en: It's dark, so it's time to leave the nest.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍在桦叶上，声音很轻
lines.en: My wings brush the birch leaves, barely a sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着树梢走，不从地面过
lines.en: I travel along the treetops, never on the ground.

lines.zh: 触角碰到枝条，同伴就知道我来了
lines.en: My antennae brush a branch and the flock knows I'm here.

lines.zh: 白天我不出门，巢里更安全
lines.en: I stay in by day; the nest is safer.

lines.zh: 两只并排飞，队形不容易散
lines.en: Two flying side by side hold formation better.

lines.zh: 这根触角比我身子还长
lines.en: These antennae are longer than my whole body.

lines.zh: 桦林边上有片空地，可以歇脚
lines.en: There's a clearing past the birches where we rest.

lines.zh: 我踩着细枝回来，巢屋在望
lines.en: I walk the thin branch home, nest house in sight.

lines.zh: 群飞的影子落在蘑菇上
lines.en: Our flock's shadow falls across the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 夜风口太凉，我贴着树皮走
lines.en: The night wind bites; I hug the bark as I go.

lines.zh: 绕开那口钟，我不想听它响
lines.en: I'll circle wide of that bell; I don't want it rung.

lines.zh: 巢屋的门口朝东，我记得。
lines.en: The nest entrance faces east; I remember that.

lines.zh: 两根触角先探进屋檐下。
lines.en: Both antennae push under the eaves first.

lines.zh: 我落在桦木反光的那一面。
lines.en: I land on the side the birch light hits.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，我跟着拐弯。
lines.en: A flockmate calls; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 巢屋的枝条松了，得补一补
lines.en: A twig in our nest house loosened; I should fix it.

lines.zh: 今天这枚蛋比昨天小一点
lines.en: Today's egg came out smaller than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 我在理头顶那对触角
lines.en: I'm grooming the pair of antennae on my head.

lines.zh: 风穿过白桦，像有人吹口哨
lines.en: Wind through the birches sounds like someone whistling.

lines.zh: 巢里还有三枚蛋，我数过了
lines.en: Three eggs remain in the nest; I counted them.

lines.zh: 白天不出声，夜里才热闹
lines.en: We're quiet by day and noisy at night.

lines.zh: 有只同伴飞回来，触角晃了两下
lines.en: A flockmate returned and flicked its antennae twice.

lines.zh: 那棵桦树歪了，巢屋跟着斜
lines.en: That birch leaned, so our nest house tilts.

lines.zh: 我在听远处的炸响，希望不是巢边
lines.en: I hear blasts far off, hoping they're not near our nest.

lines.zh: 这十点生命，够我小心一点
lines.en: Ten points of health means I stay careful.

lines.zh: 蛋壳上的斑点，每一枚都不同
lines.en: No two eggs share the same speckled pattern.

lines.zh: 我蜷下来，把触角收在翅下
lines.en: I curl up and tuck my antennae under a wing.

lines.zh: 巢屋门口朝向太阳，早上暖
lines.en: Our nest door faces the sun, warm each morning.

lines.zh: 那群羊在树下吃草，我不怕
lines.en: Sheep graze below the tree; they don't worry me.

lines.zh: 你抬头看得太久了，脖子不酸吗
lines.en: You've stared upward a while; doesn't your neck ache?

lines.zh: 你手里没有蛋，我可以放心
lines.en: No eggs in your hands, so I can relax.

lines.zh: 我认得你，昨天的脚步更轻
lines.en: I know you; yesterday your footsteps were lighter.

lines.zh: 别伸手进巢，那会让我发怒
lines.en: Keep your hand out of the nest; that angers us.

lines.zh: 你在找蛋吧，我看得出来
lines.en: You're looking for eggs; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为触角挡了眼睛
lines.en: I tilt my head because my antennae block the view.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在桦荫里
lines.en: You're standing right in the birch shade.

lines.zh: 放松点，我只在巢被碰时才动手
lines.en: Relax; I only fight when the nest is touched.

lines.zh: 你身上有钟声的回味
lines.en: You carry the echo of a bell.

lines.zh: 那群哔特里，我的触角最长
lines.en: Among the flock, my antennae are the longest.

lines.zh: 你打断了我梳理触角
lines.en: You interrupted my antennae grooming.

lines.zh: 翅膀垂下来了，飞不高
lines.en: My wing droops; I can't gain height.

lines.zh: 十点生命，经不起第二下
lines.en: Ten points of health won't survive a second hit.

lines.zh: 我落地了，快退回巢里
lines.en: I'm down; hurry back into the nest.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一地，真难看
lines.en: Feathers everywhere, an undignified look.

lines.zh: 这一下让我叫得比平时尖
lines.en: That made me screech sharper than usual.

lines.zh: 同伴在树上看着，我得撑着
lines.en: My flock is watching from the tree; I must hold.

lines.zh: 你的手比我想的重
lines.en: Your hand was heavier than I expected.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃，还是飞起来了
lines.en: I wobbled, but I still got airborne.

lines.zh: 巢还在，那就还行
lines.en: The nest is still standing, so I'm fine.

lines.zh: 桦树皮下的虫子，我确实喜欢
lines.en: The grubs under birch bark, those I do like.

lines.zh: 你摇那根树枝，我会跟过去
lines.en: Wave that branch and I'll come along.

lines.zh: 熟透的浆果比蛋更香
lines.en: Ripe berries smell better than any egg.

lines.zh: 我不抢食，除非你先放下
lines.en: I won't snatch food unless you set it down first.

lines.zh: 你手心那点种子，够我啄两下
lines.en: Those seeds in your palm are worth two pecks.

lines.zh: 别拿蛋来引我，那是同伴
lines.en: Don't use an egg as bait; that's a flockmate.

lines.zh: 巢边的虫子我不敢抓，你帮忙
lines.en: I won't grab the grubs by the nest; you try.

lines.zh: 风一吹，食物的味道就散了
lines.en: One gust scatters the smell of food.

lines.zh: 我落在你肩头，只停一会儿
lines.en: I'll land on your shoulder, only briefly.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，就别站着不动
lines.en: If you're feeding me, don't just stand there.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的巢屋了，退开
lines.en: You touched our nest house; step away.

lines.zh: 翅膀被你撞歪，一下子没飞稳
lines.en: You knocked my wing askew; I couldn't hold the air.

lines.zh: 别在树下站那么直，会顶到我
lines.en: Don't stand so straight under the tree; you clip me.

lines.zh: 我落在你帽子上，算你运气
lines.en: I landed on your hat, count yourself lucky.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我飞我的，错开
lines.en: You walk your way, I'll fly mine, let's part.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我掉了几根绒羽
lines.en: That bump cost me a few downy feathers.

lines.zh: 我个头小，撞上来你也没感觉
lines.en: I'm small; you barely feel it when I hit.

lines.zh: 巢门窄，你先让一让
lines.en: The nest door is narrow; let me through first.

lines.zh: 触角折了一下，还能用
lines.en: One antenna bent; it still works fine.

lines.zh: 你踩到地上的蛋壳了
lines.en: You stepped on a shell on the ground.

lines.zh: 我们撞成一团，同伴在笑
lines.en: We collided; the flock is laughing at us.

lines.zh: 让开那根横枝，我要落上去
lines.en: Clear that branch; I want to land on it.

lines.zh: 巢屋要盖两层，我才愿意
lines.en: Build the nest two levels high and I'll agree.

lines.zh: 你衔草，我铺底，分工正好
lines.en: You fetch grass, I line the floor, a good split.

lines.zh: 触角对上触角，就定下了
lines.en: Antenna to antenna, and it's settled.

lines.zh: 我们轮流孵蛋，白天归你
lines.en: We'll take turns on the eggs; days are yours.

lines.zh: 两枚蛋并排放，不能滚出去
lines.en: Two eggs side by side must not roll away.

lines.zh: 你的叫声比我尖一点
lines.en: Your call is a touch sharper than mine.

lines.zh: 白桦最高的那根枝，留给我们的巢
lines.en: The highest birch branch is ours for the nest.

lines.zh: 冬天的巢要加厚，你记着
lines.en: Winter nests need thicker walls; remember that.

lines.zh: 一起守夜，你守上半夜
lines.en: We'll keep watch together; you take the first half.

lines.zh: 我们飞同一棵树，才算同伴
lines.en: Only when we share one tree are we partners.

lines.zh: 这根细枝正好补巢
lines.en: This thin twig fits the nest repair perfectly.

lines.zh: 蛋壳的碎片，我收进巢底
lines.en: Shell fragments, I'll tuck them under the nest.

lines.zh: 掉下来的浆果，别浪费
lines.en: A fallen berry shouldn't go to waste.

lines.zh: 我用爪子夹住，用嘴不好拿
lines.en: I grip it with a claw; my beak can't hold it.

lines.zh: 这块树皮能挡雨
lines.en: This strip of bark will keep the rain out.

lines.zh: 那枚蛋不是我的，我得放回去
lines.en: That egg isn't mine; I must put it back.

lines.zh: 触角上挂了根草，真麻烦
lines.en: A blade of grass caught on my antennae, annoying.

lines.zh: 我把蘑菇叼回巢，慢慢吃
lines.en: I'll carry the mushroom home and eat it slowly.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛就够了，别多拿
lines.en: One feather is enough; don't take more.

lines.zh: 巢里放不下太多东西
lines.en: The nest can't hold very much stuff.

lines.zh: 有人碰了巢屋，我听见木头响
lines.en: Someone touched the nest house; I heard the wood creak.

lines.zh: 那只手伸进巢口了
lines.en: That hand just reached into the nest opening.

lines.zh: 蛋少了一枚，气味还是新的
lines.en: An egg is gone and the scent is fresh.

lines.zh: 树下那个人，袖子里鼓着
lines.en: The person under the tree has bulging sleeves.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了两声，方向在西边
lines.en: A flockmate called twice, from the west.

lines.zh: 桦树皮被剥开了，是新的痕迹
lines.en: The bark was peeled back; the marks are fresh.

lines.zh: 有脚步声靠近巢下的石头
lines.en: Footsteps are nearing the stone below the nest.

lines.zh: 那个人捧着什么，圆圆的
lines.en: That one is cradling something round.

lines.zh: 巢屋在晃，不是风
lines.en: The nest house shakes, and it isn't wind.

lines.zh: 我看见了，蛋在他手里
lines.en: I saw it; the egg is in their hand.

lines.zh: 我们整群都会来，别小看
lines.en: The whole flock will come; don't underestimate us.

lines.zh: 你跑到空地也没用
lines.en: Running to open ground won't help you.

lines.zh: 把蛋放下，我就停下
lines.en: Set the egg down and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 触角竖起，是进攻的意思
lines.en: Antennae raised means we're attacking.

lines.zh: 我个子小，但啄得准
lines.en: I'm small, but my pecks land accurately.

lines.zh: 你在树下转圈，我们跟着转
lines.en: You circle the tree; we circle with you.

lines.zh: 蛋壳在你口袋里响
lines.en: The shell is rattling in your pocket.

lines.zh: 再退一步，巢就在你背后
lines.en: One more step back and the nest is behind you.

lines.zh: 我们不追远，只护到林边
lines.en: We chase no farther than the forest edge.

lines.zh: 十点生命，也够啄你一脸
lines.en: Ten points of health is still enough to peck your face.

lines.zh: 我啄的是手背，不是蛋
lines.en: I peck the back of your hand, not the egg.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇你眼睛，你就得放手
lines.en: My wings beat at your eyes until you let go.

lines.zh: 这一下是巢屋的账
lines.en: This peck settles the debt for the nest house.

lines.zh: 我抓你头发，往上拽
lines.en: I grab your hair and pull upward.

lines.zh: 爪子小，落在手背上也疼
lines.en: My claws are small, but they sting a hand.

lines.zh: 群起而攻，你就两只手
lines.en: The whole flock attacks; you have only two hands.

lines.zh: 我专挑拿蛋的那只手
lines.en: I aim for the hand that holds the egg.

lines.zh: 别挥，越挥我越急
lines.en: Don't swat; the more you swat, the angrier I get.

lines.zh: 我只啄一下，算是警告
lines.en: I peck only once, as a warning.

lines.zh: 你指缝夹着蛋，我知道
lines.en: I know the egg is pinched between your fingers.

lines.zh: 白桦林深处，巢屋刚搭好
lines.en: Deep in the birch forest, our nest house stands.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，壳还在巢边
lines.en: I hatched here; the shell still sits by the nest.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，同伴都回巢了
lines.en: Dawn is close, and the flock has returned.

lines.zh: 这片桦林归我们，别处不去
lines.en: This birch grove is ours; we go nowhere else.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁开眼睛，全是白的树干
lines.en: I opened my eyes to a world of white trunks.

lines.zh: 触角一伸出去，就收到信号
lines.en: I stretched my antennae and picked up a signal.

lines.zh: 巢屋搭在离地三格的枝上
lines.en: Our nest house sits three blocks above the ground.

lines.zh: 母鸟留下蛋，飞走了
lines.en: The mother laid an egg and flew off.

lines.zh: 我在桦树皮上蹭了蹭嘴
lines.en: I wiped my beak against the birch bark.

lines.zh: 夜里出生的，第一眼是月亮
lines.en: Born at night, the first thing I saw was the moon.

lines.zh: 绒毛一碰到火就焦了
lines.en: My downy feathers singe the instant fire touches them.

lines.zh: 翅膀没张开，直直落下去
lines.en: My wings never opened; I dropped straight down.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸水，我浮不起来
lines.en: Wet feathers soak up water and I can't float.

lines.zh: 巨响震得我耳朵发麻
lines.en: The blast left my ears ringing and numb.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过翅膀
lines.en: An arrow punched straight through my wing.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我头晕
lines.en: The potion's smell makes my head swim.

lines.zh: 三天没吃东西，触角都软了
lines.en: Three days without food and my antennae droop.

lines.zh: 雷落在巢边，我吓掉了羽毛
lines.en: Lightning hit beside the nest and I lost feathers.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，连风都没有
lines.en: Nothing below me, not even wind.
